TEST-ONLY synthetic fixture. Not ZoikoSuite fact.

# What ZoikoSuite is
ZoikoSuite is a governed business operations platform that brings finance, workforce, tax, legal, compliance and commercial operations into one system with built-in approvals and audit evidence.
# Domains and modules
Capabilities are grouped into four domains: Finance; Workforce; Tax, Legal and Compliance; and Commercial.
# Finance modules
The Finance domain covers accounting and general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and treasury and cash position.
# Governance
Approval workflows, audit trails and segregation of duties are cross-cutting governance capabilities rather than separate modules.
